liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1979-09-05.mtx.seamons.ht63.110829.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1979-09-05.156351.senn441.senn421.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 169 min [3]
- **gd1979-09-05.nak700.glassberg.wise.2484.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Good Lovin' featured extra effort from Bobby and Jerry at MSG; Eyes was butchered by being played faster than the band could handle [18][20]
- **gd1979-09-05.151987.fob.nak700.cm.wagner.miller.t..flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 166 min [6]
- **gd1979-09-05.sbd.miller.79748.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 4.5/5 by 10 [8]. Said about its sound: Peggy-O played very up-tempo, which the reviewer found a little weird [16]

## Around the show

- A random cheer occurred because Jerry messed up the lyrics during the performance [11]
- Bob Weir's 'Fire-uuaahh!' chorus sounded weird to the listener [12]
- Twenty thousand tripping fans filled the Garden, with a searing Franklin's Tower opening [13]
- WPLJ personnel handed out free stickers to kids entering the show [14]
- During the space jam, the Garden felt like a free-falling elevator [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-09-05.mtx.seamons.ht63.110829.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16) [1]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred the SBD; Barry Glassberg recorded; Rob Bertrando handled pitch correction [1]
- **gd1979-09-05.156351.senn441.senn421.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton for the recording, as well as the transfer and harddrive; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441 (left + right) + (1) Sennheiser 421 (center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [3]. Also: Rob Eaton recorded and transferred; Bob Wagner supplied a Nakamichi 700 patch for Drums > Space [3]
- **gd1979-09-05.nak700.glassberg.wise.2484.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Nak 700's>Sony TC-158>DAT [5]
- **gd1979-09-05.151987.fob.nak700.cm.wagner.miller.t..flac16**: taped by Recorded by Bob Wagner; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 18, 2021; source: (FOB/11th Row) Nakamichi CM700 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-158SD/Dolby B) [6]. Also: Bob Wagner was patched out of Barry Glassberg; a tape flip in Drums was crossfaded [6]
- **gd1979-09-05.sbd.miller.79748.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Reel -> Dat -> PCM -> CD [8]
